findings.title: hickory 0.26 / reqwest 0.13.4 behaviour change breaks ZeroKMS connectivity in the test harness
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: Speculative resolver behaviour change with no concrete mechanism, and its own cited CI evidence shows the e2e property suite and build jobs passing on the head commit.

findings.title: Re-resolved windows-sys / macOS system-configuration edges break non-Linux developer builds
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: The lockfile does re-point windows-sys and add macOS system-configuration edges, but Cargo resolves these within declared ranges and the finding itself concedes breakage is unlikely; no concrete break mechanism is shown.
